originals.ko: 나는 네가 가기 전에 대답하고 싶지 않다고 말했어
originals.why: This line says 'I said that…' (ddudes i … bo' fi ddim). It never uses ddudes i ddim ('I didn't say'), so it does not practise this LEGO.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 그것들을 두고 왔다고 말하지 않았어

originals.why: In 'ddudes i fod o ddim' the ddim negates the reported clause, not the saying. The phrase means 'I said that…', so it does not use ddudes i ddim.

originals.ko: 나는 그가 가고 싶어하지 않는다고 말했어
originals.why: This is affirmative 'I said that he doesn't…'. It does not use the LEGO ddudes i ddim ('I didn't say').

originals.ko: 나는 네가 그가 뭘 하려고 노력하고 있는지 나에게 말하지 않았다고 말했어
originals.why: This is affirmative 'I said that…' with the reported clause negated. It does not use ddudes i ddim.
